decision.explanation: The provided sources contain conflicting assertions regarding the premiere date of The Walking Dead Season 11. Document D1 (and card d1:c0) explicitly states the premiere was 'August 2, 2020', while Document D2 (and card d2:c0) states it was 'August 22, 2021'. Both documents describe the same entity ('The eleventh and final season') and the same relation ('premiered on'). Per the instruction to preserve separately valid referents and complementary answers where competing assertions exist without external resolution, both dates are retained as supported candidates from the original source material.
